content: गिरि {%a.%} [गॄ-इ किच्च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 142</ls>] Venerable, respectable, worshipful. .{@-रिः@} .²1 A hill, mountain, an elevation; पश्याधः खनने मूढ गिरयो न पतन्ति किम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; ननु प्रवातेऽपि निष्कम्पा गिरयः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²2 A huge rock. .²3 A disease of the eyes. .²4 An honorific title given to Saṃnyāsins; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} आनन्दगिरिः .²5 (In <ab>math.</ab>) The number ‘eight’. .²6 A ball with which children play (गेन्दुक). .²7 A cloud. .²8 A peculiar defect in quicksilver. .{@-रिः@} {%f.%} .²1 Swallowing. .²2 A rat; mouse (written also गिरी in this sense).
